segments.vv54:1.3: Kūṭāgārā sattasatā uḷārā, veḷuriyathambhā rucakatthatā [ruciratthatā (syā. ka.)646 gāthāyaṃ “rucakupakiṇṇaṃ”ti padassa saṃvaṇṇanā passitabbā] subhā.
segments.vv54:2.1: “Tatthacchasi pivasi khādasi ca, dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vagguṃ [vaggu (sī. ka.), vaggū (syā.)];
segments.vv54:2.3: Dibbā rasā kāmaguṇettha pañca, nāriyo ca naccanti suvaṇṇachannā.
segments.vv54:3.1: “Kena tetādiso vaṇṇo, kena te idha mijjhati;
segments.vv54:3.3: Uppajjanti ca te bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.
segments.vv54:4.1: “Pucchāmi taṃ deva mahānubhāva, manussabhūto kimakāsi puññaṃ;
segments.vv54:4.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv54:5.3: Pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi, yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv54:7.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo, tena me idha mijjhati;
segments.vv54:7.3: Uppajjanti ca me bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.
segments.vv54:8.1: “Akkhāmi te bhikkhu mahānubhāva, manussabhūto yamakāsi puññaṃ;
segments.vv54:8.3: Tenamhi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

lines: Pivasi khādasi cāti kālena kālaṃ upayujjamānaṃ gandhapānaṃ sudhābhojanañca sandhāya vadati.
Dibbā rasā kāmaguṇettha pañcāti dibbā rasā anappakā pañca kāmaguṇā ettha etasmiṃ tava vimāne saṃvijjantīti attho.
Satisamuppādakaroti satuppādakaro, yena puññakammena ayaṃ dibbasampatti mayā laddhā, tattha satuppādassa kārako,“kakkaṭakarasadānena ayaṃ tayā sampatti laddhā”ti evaṃ satuppādaṃ karontoti attho.
Ekamekasmiṃ passe pañca pañca katvā dasa pādā etassāti dasapādako dvāre kakkaṭako ṭhito sobhati.
So eva mama puññakammaṃ tādisānaṃ mahesīnaṃ vibhāveti, na ettha mayā vattabbaṃ atthīti adhippāyo.
